purpose: The complete and exclusive business handoff parameter set for staged local training, curve review and single-image test.

learning_rate.description: Read-only effective learning rate reported by the executor for this immutable trial profile.

annotation_click_mode.description: Business-selected annotation/VERIFY interaction mode; it must match the frozen dataset revision and is included in the training receipt.

rules: training_asset_count and validation_asset_count are derived by the service after split validation; they are never manually entered.

epoch_count, iteration_count, batch_size, trial_model_id and annotation_click_mode are immutable once submitted; model and click-mode IDs must come from GetCapability, never paths or arbitrary checkpoint IDs.
The effective learning rate, training curve and scores are service-reported facts and must never be fabricated or edited by the UI.
A validation score of 0 is displayed as an observed value or unavailable-validation result, never silently converted to success.
All other model, checkpoint, optimizer, threshold, path, image and mask parameters are outside this business handoff profile.
Each submitted profile is immutable and binds request_id, dataset revision, model/runtime digest and receipt.
